identity_lookup.name: verify_granted_identity
identity_lookup.description: Inspect the current session token to learn which entity, policies, and metadata Vault bound to the authenticated principal.

response_fields.data.id: The current Vault token ID for the authenticated session
response_fields.data.entity_id: Identity entity ID bound to the authenticated session
response_fields.data.meta: Metadata copied onto the token from the auth method
response_fields.data.path: Auth path used to create the token
response_fields.data.renewable: Whether the token can be renewed
response_fields.data.orphan: Whether the token has no parent

permission_check.name: check_self_capabilities
permission_check.description: Ask Vault which capabilities the current session token has on one or more paths.

request_body.paths: list of Vault API paths to evaluate

response_fields.capabilities: Capabilities for a single queried path
response_fields.*: Per-path capability arrays for each requested path

access_test.name: verify_read_secret
access_test.description: Attempt to read a protected KV v1 secret path using the authenticated session token.

response_fields.data: Returned secret data proves read access to the protected path
response_fields.lease_duration: Advisory TTL returned with the secret if present

access_test.name: verify_read_secret_v2
access_test.description: Attempt to read a protected KV v2 secret path using the authenticated session token.

response_fields.data.data: Returned secret payload proves read access to the protected path
response_fields.data.metadata.custom_metadata: Custom metadata visible with the secret

session_token_inspect.name: lookup_token_by_accessor
session_token_inspect.description: Admin lookup of a token by accessor to inspect TTL, issue time, entity binding, and granted policies after login.

request_body.accessor: token accessor from login response auth.accessor

response_fields.data.path: Auth path that issued the token

session_token_inspect.name: lookup_token_by_value
session_token_inspect.description: Admin lookup of a token by token value to inspect session metadata and lifetime properties.

request_body.token: session token from login response auth.client_token

response_fields.data.path: Auth path that issued the token

admin_audit.name: verify_entity_details
admin_audit.description: Look up the full identity entity record by entity ID to inspect aliases, group memberships, and attached policies.

path_params.id: login response auth.entity_id or token lookup data.entity_id

response_fields.data.name: Entity name
response_fields.data.policies: Policies directly attached to the entity
response_fields.data.aliases: Aliases linked to the entity across auth mounts

admin_audit.name: lookup_entity_by_alias
admin_audit.description: Resolve an alias name and mount accessor to the canonical entity to detect identity collisions across logins or mounts.

request_body.alias_name: external alias name such as JWT user_claim value

response_fields.data.id: Canonical entity ID resolved from the alias
response_fields.data.name: Entity name
response_fields.data.aliases: Aliases attached to the resolved entity
response_fields.data.policies: Policies directly attached to the entity

admin_audit.name: read_role_config
admin_audit.description: Read the JWT/OIDC role configuration to confirm the exact constraints and grants in effect during a test.

response_fields.data.user_claim: Claim used as alias identity source
response_fields.data.groups_claim: Claim used for external group aliases

admin_audit.name: read_group_alias_by_id
admin_audit.description: Inspect a group alias created from JWT groups claims to verify external-to-internal group mapping.

path_params.id: group alias ID from create_group_alias response

response_fields.data.name: External group alias name
response_fields.data.canonical_id: Internal group ID targeted by the alias
response_fields.data.mount_accessor: Auth mount accessor the alias belongs to

admin_audit.name: read_identity_group_by_id
admin_audit.description: Inspect an identity group to verify attached policies and membership that may affect authorization.
